**Orbweaver 1.0.11 adds model and effort controls to every chat panel, lets you finish `/login` and close terminal screens from the panel or the phone, and fixes a run of problems between paired desktops.**

## What's new

- **Model dropdown and effort dial on every chat panel.** Pick the model and the effort for a session from its panel, on this machine, on a linked desktop, or from the phone. (CB-404)
- **Finish Claude Code's `/login` from the chat panel.** The panel and the phone show the sign-in link and a field for the code, including for sessions that are not in tmux. A code Claude Code refuses now shows its reason instead of nothing. (CB-412, CB-418)
- **Close a terminal screen from the panel.** When a session is showing a screen that Esc leaves (`/mobile`'s QR code, `/mcp`, `/config`, `/help`, `/memory` and the like), the panel and the phone show it with one button that sends Esc. (CB-400)
- **Browse a remote desktop's folders in New Chat.** Browse… now works for a paired machine, under the same rules as the phone's folder picker. (CB-357)
- **Trust a folder on the far machine.** When a session launched on another desktop stops at Claude Code's folder-trust prompt, the launching desktop asks "Trust this folder on <machine>?" in the New Chat window. (CB-397)
- **Notify for team leads only.** A phone can choose all, leads only, or off for turn-finished alerts, so team members stop buzzing it. (CB-358)

## What's fixed

- **The link between desktops no longer hangs on a locked keychain.** On macOS a locked login keychain, or a keychain prompt nobody answered, could stall the peer link for hours. The handshake is now bounded and the link retries. (CB-411)
- **A session that drops out of one roster and comes straight back keeps its orb.** Before, a paired machine's orb could stay gone until the app restarted. (CB-402)
- **Questions from a team lead can be answered again.** A question form in a very narrow pane is now offered with its full labels, and one slow reply no longer switches prompts off for that session. (CB-406, CB-407)
- **A question's first screen reaches a phone that connects late.** Pending prompts are sent again when a phone comes online or resyncs. (CB-401)
- **Remote typing no longer reports success when the text went nowhere.** The typing check is enforced by default and waits briefly for the prompt to be ready. (CB-403)
- **A New Chat launched on another desktop with a named account now starts.** The account folder was passed as a relative path and the session never checked in. (CB-397)
- **Live sessions stay on the phone past the orb lifetime.** A session that is still running but has been quiet no longer drops off the phone. (CB-393)
- **The status hook can no longer stall on a hung lookup**, and each run is logged to `hook.log`. (CB-394)
- **A lone orb can leave its user group by dragging**, and that group is easier to grab. (CB-332)
- **A Mac at the lock screen can be paired by script**, for headless setups. (CB-391)
- **Windows:** rows in the `/mcp` screen no longer draw over each other. (CB-400)

## Upgrading

- Install 1.0.11 from the update notice, or by hand as usual.
- The phone features above (model and effort, `/login`, team-lead alerts) need the matching Orbweaver Mobile build.
- **macOS:** if your other machines, OpenClaw or the phone relay stop connecting after the upgrade, re-grant Local Network in **System Settings → Privacy & Security**.
